summary: Dispatches an interrupt with the double value dbl_8AFEA0 via InterruptDispatch (0058957A), then triggers one of two audio-effect states on the handle a1 depending on whether that value is <= 0.5 or > 0.5: AudioEffectTrigger(0, a1) on the low path and AudioEffectTrigger(1, a1) on the high path. Invoked by sub_49D4C0 (0049D4C0).

operations.description: Load the double dbl_8AFEA0 into v1.
Call InterruptDispatch (0058957A) with dbl_8AFEA0 as its argument.
Branch on v1: the <= 0.5 path calls AudioEffectTrigger with flag 0; the > 0.5 path calls AudioEffectTrigger with flag 1.
Return AudioEffectTrigger(0, a1) on the v1 <= 0.5 path.
Return AudioEffectTrigger(1, a1) on the v1 > 0.5 path.
